headline: Gutter Erupts in Rapid Clashes While Northern Sectors Churn
war_summary: A sudden flare-up in the Gutter has reshuffled the frontline over the past two hours, with thirteen base actions across Lost Kaivo, Kuoppa, and adjacent works driving substantial territorial turnover. In Weathered Expanse and Palantine Berm, heavy contestation persists around Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest, and Windburn Landing, generating repeated ownership flips even as casualty rates in both sectors ease somewhat from earlier peaks. Nevish Line remains an escalating maelstrom of attrition, logging over thirteen hundred combined casualties in two hours alongside renewed base engagements at Blackcoat Way. Meanwhile, Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow experienced fresh shifts at Outwich Ranch and Oster Wall, though broader fighting in both sectors has cooled compared to earlier runs. Heavy attrition continues to batter Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle without yielding strategic movement, while earlier active coastal zones such as Godcrofts, Fisherman's Row, and Farranac Coast have fallen silent.
